lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Welcome to World 17, Starfall Observatory! Remember the star map from the old diary? It brought us here, to a white building on a hill. It's an observatory. People look at the stars here with a big telescope. Today, we're going to talk about plans. Today's sentence is: We're going to see the stars tonight. Say it with me. We're going to see the stars tonight. Great! We use going to for plans. これから する ことを いう ときに つかうよ。 I'm going to, you're going to, we're going to. Let's try. I'm going to eat dinner. We're going to sing a song. Good job! Now, phonics. Listen. Station. Vacation. Information. Observation. They all end with the same sound, shun. We spell it t, i, o, n. Station, vacation. Easy! Okay, what are you going to do tonight? Let's talk!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! We're in the weather room of the observatory. There are lots of screens and maps. Stargazers need good weather. If it rains, we can't see the stars! Today, we learn a new word for the future, will. Today's sentence is: Will it rain tomorrow? Say it with me. Will it rain tomorrow? Great! The answer is, I think it will. Or, I don't think so. We aren't sure about tomorrow, so we say I think. わからない ことを よそうする ときは will を つかうよ。 Let's practice. Will it be sunny tomorrow? I think it will. Will it snow tomorrow? I don't think so. Good job! Now, phonics. Television. Vision. Decision. Division. Listen to the end. Zhun. We spell it s, i, o, n. Not t, i, o, n. Okay, will it rain tomorrow where you live? Let's guess!
